optimizer: Adam with native default betas and epsilon
selection: maximum official validation Hits@50; earliest epoch on exact tie
training_objective: native own BCE for each independent model; mean member BCE for factorized family
factor_initialization: R random signs, S one, shared bias; factor seed optimizer_seed+90000
dropout_seed: optimizer_seed+1000000+epoch; native independent calls and factorized member tensor layouts differ, not exact paired dropout masks
parameter_match_rule: nearest integer width 2..4096 to factorized total trainable count; smaller width on tie; no labels or predictions used
